name: parasail
long_description: Bring a standard Parasail inference key; read-only management keys cannot run inference. Inference is charged to your Parasail account. Saving, replacing and testing keys only list models and do not verify inference permissions or credit balance. The gateway keeps the key off your Sprite. Supports chat completions, completions, embeddings and model discovery, including SSE responses. Deployment management, files and batches are not supported.

examples.title: Chat completion (charged to your Parasail account)
notes: Replace the model placeholder with an inference model from the list.

messages.402: Parasail credits exhausted or spending limit reached
messages.403: Parasail key lacks permission to list models; check the key's access permissions
messages.429: Parasail rate limit reached; retry later

presentation.tagline: OpenAI-compatible inference without storing your Parasail key on a Sprite.
presentation.setup: Create a standard inference key at www.saas.parasail.io/keys.

notices.title: Key
notices.body: Use a standard inference key, not a read-only management key. Saving, replacing and testing only list models; a successful check does not verify inference permissions or credit balance.

notices.title: Billing and scope
notices.body: Inference is charged to your Parasail account. Only `POST` chat/completions, completions, embeddings and `GET` models under `/v1` are forwarded. SSE streaming is supported; deployment management, files and batches are not.
